name: Tumbao anticipado
desc: Latin-jazz tumbao bass in Eb major: the anticipated pattern that never lands on 1 - fifth on the and-of-2, root anchoring beat 4 and tied across the barline - walking a I-IV-V-IV montuno loop; peak doubles into an octave-jump descarga drive.

root.doc: semitone offset from Eb major home

code.full: note("<[~ ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~ eb2@2] [~ ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~ ab1@2] [~ ~ ~ f2 ~ ~ bb1@2] [~ ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~ ab1 bb1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.008).decay(.25).sustain(.42).release(.15).shape(${drive}).lpf(sine.range(700,1100).slow(16)).clip(.92).gain(${gain}).room(.2).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply("1 1 1 1 1 1 2 1")).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[~ ~ eb1 bb1 ~ ~ eb2@2] [~ ~ ~ eb2 ~ eb2 ab1@2] [~ ~ ~ f2 ~ ~ bb1@2] [~ bb1 ~ eb2 ~ db2 ab1 bb1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.006).decay(.22).sustain(.4).release(.12).shape(${drive}+.1).lpf(sine.range(800,1300).slow(8)).clip(.9).gain(${gain}), note("<[~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ eb3 ~] [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ab2 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").decay(.12).sustain(0).lpf(1600).shape(.25).gain(${gain}*.4)).room(.18).orbit(3).play()
